default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Send the prefix key' C-b { send-prefix }
bind -N 'Rotate through the panes' C-o { rotate-window }
bind -N 'Suspend the current client' C-z { suspend-client }

default_bindings.note: Break pane to a new window
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Break pane to a new window' ! { break-pane }

default_bindings.note: Prompt for window index to select
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Prompt for window index to select' "'" { command-prompt -pindex { select-window -t ':%%' } }

default_bindings.note: Toggle pane between floating and tiled
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Toggle pane between floating and tiled' @ { if -F '#{pane_floating_flag}' { join-pane } { break-pane -W } }

default_bindings.note: Delete the most recent paste buffer
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Delete the most recent paste buffer' - { delete-buffer }
bind -N 'Move the current window' . { command-prompt { move-window -t '%%' } }

default_bindings.note: Move to the previously active pane
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Move to the previously active pane' \; { last-pane }

default_bindings.note: Choose a paste buffer from a list
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Choose a paste buffer from a list' = { choose-buffer -Z }

default_bindings.note: Choose and detach a client from a list
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Choose and detach a client from a list' D { choose-client -Z }
bind -N 'Spread panes out evenly' E { select-layout -E }
bind -N 'Switch to the last client' L { switch-client -l }
bind -N 'Clear the marked pane' M { select-pane -M }
bind -N 'Change the pane title' T { command-prompt -I'#T' { select-pane -T '%%' } }

default_bindings.note: Paste the most recent paste buffer
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Paste the most recent paste buffer' ] { paste-buffer -p }
bind -N 'Create a new window' c { new-window }
bind -N 'Detach the current client' d { detach-client }
bind -N 'Search for a pane' f { command-prompt { find-window -Z -- '%%' } }
bind -N 'Select the previously current window' l { last-window }
bind -N 'Toggle the marked pane' m { select-pane -m }
bind -N 'Select the next window' n { next-window }
bind -N 'Select the next pane' o { select-pane -t:.+ }
bind -N 'Select the previous window' p { previous-window }
bind -N 'Redraw the current client' r { refresh-client }

default_bindings.note: Choose a session from a list
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Choose a session from a list' s { choose-tree -Zs }
bind -N 'Switch to a window' Tab { new-pane -E -x75% -y30% -X0 -Y0; move-pane -P bottom-centre; switch-mode -wk }
bind -N 'Switch to a session' BTab { new-pane -E -x75% -y30% -X0 -Y0; move-pane -P bottom-centre; switch-mode -sk }

default_bindings.note: Choose a window from a list
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Choose a window from a list' w { choose-tree -Zw }
bind -N 'Kill the active pane' x { confirm-before -p"kill-pane #P? (y/n)" kill-pane }
bind -N 'Zoom the active pane' z { resize-pane -Z }

default_bindings.note: Swap the active pane with the pane above
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Swap the active pane with the pane above' '{' { swap-pane -U }

default_bindings.note: Swap the active pane with the pane below
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Swap the active pane with the pane below' '}' { swap-pane -D }

default_bindings.note: Enter copy mode and scroll up
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Enter copy mode and scroll up' PPage { copy-mode -u }

default_bindings.note: Select the pane above the active pane
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Select the pane above the active pane' -r Up { select-pane -U }

default_bindings.note: Select the pane below the active pane
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Select the pane below the active pane' -r Down { select-pane -D }

default_bindings.note: Select the pane to the left of the active pane
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Select the pane to the left of the active pane' -r Left { select-pane -L }

default_bindings.note: Select the pane to the right of the active pane
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Select the pane to the right of the active pane' -r Right { select-pane -R }
bind -N 'Set the even-horizontal layout' M-1 { select-layout even-horizontal }
bind -N 'Set the even-vertical layout' M-2 { select-layout even-vertical }
bind -N 'Set the main-horizontal layout' M-3 { select-layout main-horizontal }
bind -N 'Set the main-vertical layout' M-4 { select-layout main-vertical }
bind -N 'Select the tiled layout' M-5 { select-layout tiled }
bind -N 'Set the main-horizontal-mirrored layout' M-6 { select-layout main-horizontal-mirrored }
bind -N 'Set the main-vertical-mirrored layout' M-7 { select-layout main-vertical-mirrored }

default_bindings.note: Select the next window with an alert
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Select the next window with an alert' M-n { next-window -a }

default_bindings.note: Rotate through the panes in reverse
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Rotate through the panes in reverse' M-o { rotate-window -D }

default_bindings.note: Select the previous window with an alert
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Select the previous window with an alert' M-p { previous-window -a }

default_bindings.note: Move the visible part of the window up
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Move the visible part of the window up' -r S-Up { refresh-client -U 10 }

default_bindings.note: Move the visible part of the window down
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Move the visible part of the window down' -r S-Down { refresh-client -D 10 }

default_bindings.note: Move the visible part of the window left
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Move the visible part of the window left' -r S-Left { refresh-client -L 10 }

default_bindings.note: Move the visible part of the window right
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Move the visible part of the window right' -r S-Right { refresh-client -R 10 }

default_bindings.note: Reset so the visible part of the window follows the cursor
default_bindings.command: bind -N 'Reset so the visible part of the window follows the cursor' -r DC { refresh-client -c }
bind -N 'Resize the pane up by 5' -r M-Up if -F '#{?floating_pane_flag}' { resizep -D-5 } { resize-pane -U 5 }
bind -N 'Resize the pane down by 5' -r M-Down { resize-pane -D 5 }
bind -N 'Resize the pane left by 5' -r M-Left if -F '#{?floating_pane_flag}' { resizep -R-5 } { resize-pane -L 5 }
bind -N 'Resize the pane right by 5' -r M-Right resize-pane -R 5
bind -N 'Resize the pane up' -r C-Up if -F '#{?floating_pane_flag}' { resizep -D-1 } { resize-pane -U }
bind -N 'Resize the pane down' -r C-Down { resize-pane -D }
bind -N 'Resize the pane left' -r C-Left if -F '#{?floating_pane_flag}' { resizep -R-1 } { resize-pane -L }
bind -N 'Resize the pane right' -r C-Right { resize-pane -R }
bind -N 'Move a floating pane' g { switch-client -Tmove }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to top-left corner' 1 { move-pane -P top-left }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to top-right corner' 2 { move-pane -P top-right }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to bottom-left corner' 3 { move-pane -P bottom-left }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to bottom-right corner' 4 { move-pane -P bottom-right }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to top-left corner and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to top-left corner and resize' M-1 { resize-pane -x50% -y50%; move-pane -P top-left }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to top-right corner and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to top-right corner and resize' M-2 { resize-pane -x50% -y50%; move-pane -P top-right }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to bottom-left corner and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to bottom-left corner and resize' M-3 { resize-pane -x50% -y50%; move-pane -P bottom-left }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to bottom-right corner and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to bottom-right corner and resize' M-4 { resize-pane -x50% -y50%; move-pane -P bottom-right }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to top' 'Up' { move-pane -P top-centre }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to bottom' 'Down' { move-pane -P bottom-centre  }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to left' 'Left' { move-pane -P centre-left }
bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to right' 'Right' { move-pane -P centre-right }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to top and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to top and resize' 'M-Up' { resizep -x100% -y50%; move-pane -P top-centre }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to bottom and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to bottom and resize' 'M-Down' { resizep -x100% -y50%; move-pane -P bottom-centre  }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to left and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to left and resize' 'M-Left' { resizep -x50% -y100%; move-pane -P centre-left }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to right and resize
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to right and resize' 'M-Right' { resizep -x50% -y100%; move-pane -P centre-right }

default_bindings.note: Move pane to fill the window
default_bindings.command: bind -Tmove -N 'Move pane to fill the window' 0 { resize-pane -x100% -y100%; move-pane -P top-left }
